[[File:Rancor_Cave_3.jpg|200px|thumb|The interior of the Rancor Cave.]]
The '''Rancor Cave''' was a cave on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], located right next to the [[Nightsister Stronghold]]. It was populated by many [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]].<ref name="SWG:RC" />

Hidden in the deepest parts of the cave and guarded by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] lay the entrance to the [[Chamber of Banishment]], where [[Axkva Min]] was imprisoned.<ref name="SWG:AM" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rancor Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rancor Cave was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
